observations_and_questions.classification: new source-level conditional candidate; global alias and supported-call reachability unresolved
observations_and_questions.trace: PatternSpec stores public panels and an optional panel_order. panel_order(false) caches define_panel_order only when absent. If a caller requests order on an empty pattern, then merges a pattern with a new panel, merge appends that panel but does not invalidate the cached empty list. Later serialize with empty_ok=false asks panel_order(false) and returns its empty-pattern error despite retained panels; drawing likewise returns an empty drawing. If a nonempty order was cached before a new named panel is appended, to_json includes the new panel entry while retaining the older order; drawing only iterates the cached names. A publicly mutable panels list and panel_mut also permit other order-staleness sequences.
observations_and_questions.limits: No pattern, serializer, drawing, fixture, or executable was run. No supported producer that requests ordering before a later mutation or merge was established. The inspected component assembly starts with PatternSpec::empty and merges children before the selected CLI serializes, so this trace does not establish failure in that ordinary route. The cache may intentionally represent an externally agreed order; required invalidation/preservation policy and all real callers remain open. Historical q316 discusses panel identity/merge broadly; no automatic alias or independent global count is asserted.
observations_and_questions.future_direction: Decide whether stored order is derived cache or authoritative explicit order; then give panel membership and geometry changes coherent update/invalidation semantics, including deliberate externally supplied orders. Acceptance must cover supported mutation/merge sequences, serialization and drawing after ordering, without changing legitimate order policy. Work is not implemented or validated.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Selected component creates and merges patterns; CLI serializes; fitter and drawing consume panels. Other public callers and input decoders remain open.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: PatternSpec, PanelSpec, EdgeSpec and StitchSide retain related names and indices; candidate identity owner must cover actual generator, format, fitter and consumers.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Public raw endpoint indices and Vec control payloads meet unchecked edge_as_curve indexing; existing F066/current edge candidate preserved with producer reachability unproved.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Normalization and cached order depend on preconditions and mutation ordering; inspect supported failure and rollback policy before claiming reachable product impact.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Panel names, stitch references, edge endpoints and order relate to the current panels/edges; independent fields do not prove those relationships.
thirteen_lenses.wrong-duplicate-owners: One shared panel identity policy must reconcile first lookup and fitter name map; duplicate acceptance or separate namespace policy is not assumed.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Public panels and stored order can disagree after public merge; distinction between derived cache and authoritative explicit order remains to be decided.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Preserve established assembly, insertion/name semantics and intentional Python-style format only to the extent required by current supported contracts; no blanket historical compatibility mandate.
thirteen_lenses.enum-state-shape: Curvature already owns variant payloads but control-point arity is retained as Vec; no assumption that circle flags or normalization booleans need merging.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Handwritten JSON writer explicitly preserves key order and Python-like number spelling; evaluate serializers only with exact wire requirements and consumer policy, no assumed equivalent derive.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Endpoint and stitch indices have different owning collections; dimensional radius, translations, coordinates, and units have distinct roles requiring contract-specific types.
thirteen_lenses.raw-strings: Panel/stitch names remain open authored references, escaped at JSON boundaries; duplicate and missing reference policy is not proof names form a closed enum.
thirteen_lenses.raw-primitives: Units-in-meter and centimeter conversions, coordinates, curvature values and tolerance are distinct semantic quantities; do not assert a universal range or units policy without producer and consumer evidence.
